# Structural GitHub Actions lint contract for this component repository.
# ShellCheck and Pyflakes are disabled explicitly; this is not a claim that
# their diagnostics (including existing release SC2129) are absent.
@version 1.7.12
@cwd ./
@flag -no-color
@flag -shellcheck=
@flag -pyflakes=
@flag -oneline
@target .github/workflows/*.yml
@target .github/workflows/*.yaml
@max 0
